_source: docs/DISTRIBUTION.md §7 preset table + docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md §4; env surface = brain/llm.py make_backend (M11.5 PR-3, ADR-060)
_note: All presets except 'anthropic' use LLM_BACKEND=openai (OpenAI-compatible seam, ADR-019). base_url values mirror the DISTRIBUTION §7 table: only 'ollama' and 'litellm' are services this repo's docker-compose actually defines — for 'vllm'/'localai' add a same-named compose service or point base_url at your host (e.g. http://localhost:8000/v1); 'llamacpp'/'lmstudio'/'tgi' use a generic host:<port> placeholder you must replace (TGI has no default port). api_key: 'anthropic_env'=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; 'real'=provider key; 'noauth'=ignored but the OpenAI SDK requires a non-empty string. vision/structured default OFF for every openai-compatible backend (opt-in in brain/llm.py via LLM_VISION=1/LLM_STRUCTURED=1; many endpoints incl. text-only DeepSeek and most local runtimes don't support them) and ON only for native anthropic. The 'sampling' backend (schema enum) is MCP host-supplied (mcp-server mode), not a wizard preset.

openai.label: Cloud — OpenAI-compatible (OpenAI/DeepSeek/OpenRouter)
openai.note: set the provider's /v1 base_url + a real key; OpenAI itself supports vision+structured — set LLM_VISION=1/LLM_STRUCTURED=1 if your model does

litellm.label: LiteLLM (router)
litellm.note: routes many providers (ADR-045; image in deploy/litellm)
